findings.summary: The exported principal normalizer accepts a provider-token-shaped capability and returns the raw value.
findings.observation: normalizePrincipal accepts capabilities matching its identifier regex without calling assertNoCredentialMaterial; an independent ghp-shaped capability was returned unchanged, and store.create accepted the same actor capability.
findings.refutation: This is an API-boundary acceptance of raw provider-token-shaped material despite the task goal requiring rejection at every API boundary.

findings.summary: The public event schema accepts secret-shaped terminal reasons.
findings.observation: A Draft-2020-12-compatible Ajv probe accepted both a provider-token-shaped reason and a neutral valid base64 reason. The runtime normalizeReason path rejects both, but terminalData.reason has only type, maxLength, and printable-character constraints and no credentialValueShape exclusion.
findings.refutation: A schema-only API consumer can pass raw credential-shaped reason material that the runtime boundary refuses, so the public API/event contract is not uniformly fail-closed.
